capabilities: Push a note to Lavadocs via a sidebar icon
Authenticate with a Lava Key from a Lavadocs account
extras: Freemium: hosted edition includes 50 free documents, then $4.99 per 100 documents; a self-hosted edition is available on a pay-what-you-want basis. A Lavadocs privacy policy governs how pushed docs are stored.
motivation: The author mentions privacy as part of the reason they built it: "It’s part of the reason I built this."
problem: Obsidian keeps notes local, so sharing a single document publicly requires copying it out to another service manually.

relations.evidence: This plugin integrates your Obsidian vault with Lavadocs

requires.name: Lavadocs hosted edition beyond 50 free documents

summary: Publishing integration that pushes individual notes from your vault to Lavadocs for sharing as public docs.
